tei:div.tei:p: blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zag bcas dge ba'i stobs bskyed pa'i chos bzhugs so/ /lus dang srog la mi lta zhing / /rgyal srid bya dga' mi bsten par/ /dka' spyad bzod pa bsgoms pa yi/ /dpa' bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtam 'di nyon dang rtag 'dzin can/ /las 'di sems dang khur po can/ /skye ba gtan gyi sa bon de/ /tshe thung 'di la sgrub dgos na/ /long yod bsten pa'i snying med po/ /gdon 'di gang gis slad pa yin/ /slar yang skyid 'dod ches pas phung / /de ltar yin mod zur 'go rags/ /da dung gshis ngan ma spangs na/ /rgyu 'dis shin tu phung ba yin/ /da dung gzhan don ma bsams par/ /nga dgos 'ba' zhig brten byas na/ /rang gzhan thams cad mgo bskor nas/ /mnar med gnas su nges par 'jug /tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin shags 'debs kyis/ /'dre rtog zur mgo su bas rags/ /na tsha sdug bsngal su bas mang / /gzer zug sdug bsngal nad du che/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'dra/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal su bas che/ /bkres skom 'jigs skrag yi dwags 'dra/ /dug sbrul khyi smyon nyid dang mtshungs/ /yod na yod pas skyong phyir sdug /med na med pas 'tshol phyir 'khyams/ /gang ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal gsos/ /ci ltar byas kyang skabs don stor/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ches pas lan/ /sdug sran snying rus chung bas lan/ /byams pa'i zhing sa ral bas lan/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba chad pas lan/ /sems bskyed dge ba stor bas lan/ /ma rabs grogs la brten pas lan/ /de rnams thams cad 'das pa'i chos/ /mdun ma brlag zin yar la mchod/ /da ni su la'ang re ma che/ /phyi nang gang la'ang dgos ma 'cha'/ /don med rtog pa'i sngon ma bsu/ /sngar byas ngan pa'i rjes ma bcad/ /bdag 'dzin byed re zhe mna' skyol/ /ngan shags byed re zhe mna' skyol/ /mi la 'dzugs re zhe mna' skyol/ /'dod yon sems re zhe mna' skyol/ /jo bo sems can mar bsams la/

/sdug gyur thams cad rang gis khur/ /duḥkha thams cad rang gis long / /khrel brdas chen po rang la gyis/ /soms shig soms shig 'jigs pa soms/ /zlog cig sngar byas las ngan bzlog /de ltar nyon mongs rab chod la/ /phyi nang dus skabs thams cad du/ /bdag 'di'i duḥkha ma bzung zhig /las ngan bsog na khrom du sgrogs/ /ngo lkog byas na kha dman phog /nang dbyen gyis la nang tshang bshig /spyod ngan dgug la tho les thob/ /gtsang rtog skyes tshe mdze ros 'dul/ /gdon rtog skyes tshe gnyan dgu 'grims/ /skyug bro skyes tshe snag khrag 'jibs/ /kha rgyang ma che bdag 'dzin bskyur/ /byin rlabs ma zhu 'dre la byin/ /mthu bo che la blo ma gtad/ /mo bon dag la blo mi dbab/ /drag sngags dag la sems mi gtad/ /rdzas dang ling kha rang la bya/ /'dre gdon nad kyis btab pa na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bo thams cad phyir la khyed/ /ma hā ka la la sogs pa'i/ /gtum po thams cad pha tshang khyed/ /nga ni de ring lan chags 'jal/ /srung skyob rwa mda' sgron re shi/ /de ring 'khor 'das shan shun 'byed/ /'dus shig 'dus shig sha za dang / /dbugs len thams cad rtsa 'dir 'dus/ /sha bshu'i rogs la sleb par shog /sha bgos grogs la sleb par shog /khyed rnams nga yi pha ma yin/ /bu yi sha khrag rol du gsol/ /khyed ni drin can pha ma yin/ /de ring bzang lan len du shog /sngon chad lus sems gces par bzung / /rgyu des da dung 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sngon chad bya dga' rang gis khyer/ /rgyu des da dung na tshas btab/ /sngon chad gnod pa gzhan la skyel/ /rgyu des khur po ri bas lci/ /sngon chad byas pas 'gyod lugs la/ /da ni khur khrig za ri shi/ /sngon ni bdag 'dzin bsrung srung nas/ /kha tsam tshig gis skyabs 'gro dran/ /da ni skyabs gsum mthu che yang / /da ni bdag 'di'i rgyab mi byed/ /phung byed 'di yi gting ma rdzi/ /gal te thugs rjes skyabs byed na/

/'dzin pa nang du brlag par gyis/ /bzung ba phyi ru brlag par gyis/ /chags sdang rang sar brlag par gyis/ /phyis ni sdang ba med par gyis/ /da ni lan chags ston mo 'gyed/ /mgron ris srid rtse man chad nas/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad yan chad na/ /lus dang longs spyod bya dga' dang / /dbugs dang mdangs dang gzi brjid rnams/ /gang la dgos pa thams cad 'dus/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu shog /thog med dus nas gces bzung ba'i/ /sha khrag 'di la dga' bar rol/ /lan chags zo la phyis ma rnyog /mgron ris stong phrag brgyad cu shog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga shog /gnod sbyin sha za 'byung po shog /pho bdud bdud kyi pho nya shog /mo bdud las kyi srin mo shog /pho bdud rgyal 'gong sa bdag shog /thams cad 'dir shog sha khrag rol/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas/ /rkang mthil sor mo yan chad la/ /kho bo zhen chags mi byed kyi/ /thams cad bag phob tshim par zo/ /sha khyer khrag 'thung rus pa mur/ /mgo bo yan lag don snying khyer/ /lhu tshigs nang khrol chu ser khyer/ /mdor na klad lpags la sogs pa'i/ /lus 'di phyi nang thams cad kyis/ /bzar nyan gcad nyan thams cad la/ /khu mkhrigs ma byed tshim par rol/ /zhi bar gyis la brlag par gyis/ /phung bar gyis la rtsa ba chod/ /chom chom myog myog bdag la ya/ /sha khrag tshal ba bdag la ya/ /rbad rbad thum thum bdag la ya/ /hūm̐ dza:phyis 'di med par gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun chod cig /las ngan phung po rabs chod cig /sngon chad lus 'di gces par bzung / /da ni bdag nyid brlag par mdzod/ /ma rungs brlag pa'i mthu stobs can/ /sha khrag rol ba'i gdug pa can/ /dbugs len gshed po sa ma ya/ /khyed kyis bdag 'di choms par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams las lhag /khyod kyis bdag 'di ma choms na/ /rang rang las kyis brlag par 'gyur/ /da ni shes nas 'jigs pa yis/ /tshogs rdzogs 'ching ba grol bar 'dod/

/de las grol bar ma gyur na/ /'dir tshogs gshed ma thams cad kyis/ /rlung dang mkhris dang bad kan dang / /'dus pa nad kyi phung po dang / /mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po mthong / /snang yul srid pa'i 'khor 'das na/ /mi 'dod ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad bdag gi steng du thong / /'gro kun nyon mongs las dang ni/ /sdug bsngal srid pa khegs par gyis/ /nges par sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal rang gi snying nang du/ /da lta nyid du smin par shog /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /las ngan rgyu 'bras drungs phyung nas/ /spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag la yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /thams cad 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs thob gyur te/ /byams dang snying rje chen po'i dpal/ /chos sku nyag gcig thob pa na/ /de las byung ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /bdag nyid 'khor bar ga la lus/ /gang yang byang chub ma thob bar/ /myong gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /tshe 'dir rgyud la smin par shog /tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /da lo nyid la smin par shog /de yang zla ba 'di la shog /de yang de ring nyid la shog /de yang skad cig 'di la shog /de ring gzer thung la sogs pa'i/ /zug zer drag po myong ba'i tshe/ /nad 'di 'gro ba yongs kyi nad/ /dgos khur nyid du blangs pa yin/ da ni thog tu phebs pa yin/ /gtong len gnad du song ba yin/ /a la la ho nga re dga'/ /nges par sems can bde ste mchi/ /sdug bsngal bdag gis lon pa yin/ /da ni go re bcad do zhes/ /na tsha skyes pa tsam gyis kyang / /'os med na tsha 'dus pa yin/ /na go bdag gi chod pa yin/ /tsha go bdag gi chod pa yin/ /bkres skom 'khyags go chod pa yin/ /lus la na tsha skyes gyur kyang / /sems kyi dga' ba 'phel bar bya/
